scope: Measurement bridge from raw recognition probe responses to signal-detection sensitivity and explicit identifiability limits for any future executable encoding state; no active registry promotion or runtime.

source_task.source_terminology_note: The article prose uses the word hit broadly while explaining correct recognition responses. CBD does not inherit that wording and uses standard yes/no SDT contingency definitions.

raw_cells.definition: Count of previously presented target probes answered seen.
Count of previously presented target probes answered not seen.
Count of foil probes not previously presented but answered seen.
Count of foil probes not previously presented and answered not seen.

reference_estimator.measurement_boundary: The estimator is a transparent CBD reference convention. It does not establish that recognition-memory evidence distributions have equal variance or that the Shulman source used the same extreme-rate correction.

measurement_quantities.definition: Signal-detection sensitivity derived from target/foil recognition responses under the registered CBD reference estimator.
measurement_quantities.what_it_is_not: Not attention, gaze, fixation, event-level encoding probability, recollection, familiarity, comprehension or belief.

measurement_quantities.definition: Reference SDT response-criterion diagnostic derived from the same corrected hit and false-alarm rates.
measurement_quantities.what_it_is_not: Not recognition sensitivity, memory strength, encoding quality or a model state.

measurement_quantities.definition: Standardized target-versus-foil evidence-distribution mean separation under the equal-variance Gaussian SDT reference model.
measurement_quantities.what_it_is_not: Not a probability, per-item state, biological encoding strength, attention, recollection, familiarity or belief.

drecog_alone_identifies: recognition discriminability under the registered measurement convention

drecog_plus_crecog_reference_inverse.boundary: This inversion reconstructs corrected operating-point rates only inside the equal-variance reference model and still does not identify an encoding mechanism.

model_assumption_boundary.reason: The standard d-prime formula is transparent and matches the reported sensitivity family, but recognition-memory ROCs often show unequal target/foil evidence variance.
model_assumption_boundary.richer_model_requirement: A future unequal-variance or multi-process recognition model requires additional identifying data such as multiple confidence criteria/ROC information or other independent constraints.

sources.citation: Shulman, H. C., Markowitz, D. M., & Rogers, T. (2024). Reading dies in complexity: Online news consumers prefer simple writing. Science Advances, 10(23), eadn2555.
Stanislaw, H., & Todorov, N. (1999). Calculation of signal detection theory measures. Behavior Research Methods, Instruments, & Computers, 31(1), 137-149.
Hautus, M. J. (1995). Corrections for extreme proportions and their biasing effects on estimated values of d-prime. Behavior Research Methods, Instruments, & Computers, 27(1), 46-51.

Spanton, R. W., & Berry, C. J. (2020). The unequal variance signal-detection model of recognition memory: Investigating the encoding variability hypothesis. Quarterly Journal of Experimental Psychology, 73(8), 1242-1260.

planned_patterns.name: SDT reconstruction
planned_patterns.pattern: Registered hit, miss, false-alarm and correct-rejection counts must yield finite Drecog and Crecog under the CBD reference estimator.

planned_patterns.name: Recognition sensitivity direction
planned_patterns.pattern: At comparable response criterion and probe structure, improved target-versus-foil discrimination must correspond to higher Drecog.

planned_patterns.name: Criterion is not sensitivity
planned_patterns.pattern: A response-criterion shift must not be represented as an encoding or recognition-sensitivity state change.

planned_patterns.name: Drecog does not identify Pencode
planned_patterns.pattern: No deterministic conversion from Drecog alone to an item-level Pencode is permitted.

planned_patterns.name: Raw SDT cells remain reconstructable
planned_patterns.pattern: When recognition responses are ingested or simulated, the four standard contingency counts must remain reconstructable rather than retaining only Drecog.

planned_patterns.name: Equal variance is a measurement assumption
planned_patterns.pattern: The equal-variance Gaussian SDT convention must not be represented as established recognition-memory physiology or a uniquely identified cognitive process.

planned_patterns.name: Standard SDT cell ontology
planned_patterns.pattern: CBD must retain standard hit, miss, false-alarm and correct-rejection definitions even where source prose uses broader informal terminology.

required_future_comparison: discrete or mixture encoding candidate only with explicit guessing, criterion and lure assumptions plus additional identifying evidence
next_candidate_gate.acceptance_boundary: A future candidate is not validated merely because one free parameter can be tuned to reproduce the published condition mean d-prime values.
